name: Vortex mixer
description: A heavy bench mixer with a rubber cup on top. Pressed into the cup, a test tube shakes until its contents mix.
notes: 128 by 168 mm and 148 mm tall: a white sloped base, a dark front panel with a speed dial and a red rocker switch, and a black rubber cup. The box counts the sloping sides and the cup standing above the base. Needs mains power; no mixing quality is in use yet, so it declares none.

name: Weather glass
description: A sealed glass pear half full of water on a wooden stand, with a thin open spout climbing beside it. The water in the spout rises and falls with the air pressure.
notes: 492 mm tall, a body 200 mm across on a turned oak stand, glass-clear with water inside and a cork-stoppered fill neck. The tile draws the glass opaque; it stays see-through in game. The box counts the air round the pear and the spout. Reading the pressure needs a use action the item schema does not have yet.

name: Briefcase weather station
description: An old weather station built into a hard briefcase: a green monochrome screen in the lid, a keypad and two dials in the base.
notes: 400 by 300 mm, modelled open with the lid tilted back so the screen faces the iso view; aluminium shell, grille, printer slot and front handle. The box counts the open lid; closed it is about 60 mm thick. Weather readings need a use action the item schema does not have yet.

name: Hide shelter bundle
description: A dozen peeled poles under a rolled hide, tied with rawhide thongs. Set up, it makes a lean-to for one.
notes: 900 mm long: twelve 30 mm poles, some still in bark, staggered at the ends, under a rolled hide 120 mm across, three thongs. The box counts the gaps in the bundle. Setting it up as a placed shelter needs a placed-object field the item schema does not have yet.

name: Damaged hide shelter bundle
description: A bundle of shelter poles and a rolled hide. One pole is snapped and the hide is torn.
notes: A distinct state of the shelter bundle, so its own model from the same builder: one pole snapped short with a splintered end and a torn hide flap hanging on the near side. Repairing it into the whole bundle is a recipe for when recipes land.

name: Large hide shelter bundle
description: A long bundle of heavy poles under a thick rolled hide, tied with rawhide thongs. Set up, it makes a shelter for several people.
notes: 3 m long: twelve 40 mm pine poles under a rolled hide 160 mm across, four thongs. The box counts the gaps in the bundle. Too long for most bags; it is meant to be dragged or carried on the shoulder. Look with --size 512: the iso tile reads dark at the default size.

name: Family tent
description: A family tent packed in a green storage bag with two compression straps and the poles in a zipped side pocket.
notes: 776 mm long and 160 mm across, a drawstring end with a toggle and a white label panel. Kept short so the bag has a believable girth for its volume. Pitching it needs a placed-object field the item schema does not have yet.

name: One-person tent
description: A small tent packed in a red stuff sack with two compression straps and the poles in a zipped side pocket.
notes: 500 mm long and 100 mm across, from the same bag builder as the family tent. The length follows the volume so the bag keeps a believable thickness. Pitching it needs a placed-object field the item schema does not have yet.
